summary.headline: Hanshin Construction wins KRW 65.7bn share of Pyeongtaek public housing project with KLH
summary.what_happened: Hanshin Construction Co., Ltd. signed a supply contract for construction work on the Pyeongtaek Godeok A-69BL and A-71BL integrated private-participation public housing project, located within the Pyeongtaek Godeok international development district in Gyeonggi-do. The counterparty is Korea Land & Housing Corporation (KLH), and the contract was concluded on Nov 26, 2026, with a period running from Nov 26, 2026 to Sep 30, 2030.

key_numbers.label: Share of contract amount vs. latest revenue

summary.why_it_matters: Large construction contract filings in Korea generally indicate new order backlog that may contribute to future revenue for construction companies, and disclosure is required when a contract exceeds a set share of revenue. Contract amounts and periods can change as construction progresses.
